units.source_text: 源氏公子看了答诗，独自躺着出了一会神，但觉心情郁结，无法排遣。

en.t: Prince Genji read the answering poem and lay alone for a while, lost in thought, feeling only a heavy sadness he could not shake off.

units.source_text: 为欲慰情，照例走到西殿去看看紫姬。

en.t: To comfort himself, he went as usual to the western wing to see Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 此时公子鬓发蓬松，衣冠不整，随意披着一件褂子，拿着一支横笛，

en.t: At this time his sidelocks were disheveled, his dress was untidy, he had casually thrown on a robe, and he was holding a transverse flute,

units.source_text: 一面吹出可爱的曲调，一面走进紫姬房里来。

en.t: playing a charming melody as he came into Lady Murasaki's room.

units.source_text: 但见紫姬歪着身子躺着，正像适才摘的那枝带露的抚子花，非常美丽可爱。

en.t: He saw Lady Murasaki lying with her body tilted to one side, as lovely and beautiful as the dewy pink flower that had just been picked.

units.source_text: 她装出撒娇模样，为的是公子回邸后不立刻来看她，故而生气，

en.t: She put on a petulant, spoiled look because she was angry that he had not come to see her immediately after returning home,

units.source_text: 不像平日那样起来迎接，却背转了脸。

en.t: and instead of rising to greet him as she usually did, she turned her face away.

units.source_text: 源氏公子在一旁坐下，叫她：“到这里来呀！”

en.t: Prince Genji sat down beside her and called, "Come over here."

units.source_text: 她只当不听见，低声唱着古歌“春潮淹没矶头草”[\[8\]](#part1336.html#m8)，用袖子遮住了口，样子潇洒而又妩媚。

en.t: She pretended not to hear him, softly sang the old poem "The spring tide covers the grass on the rocky shore"[\[8\]](#part1336.html#m8), and covered her mouth with her sleeve, looking elegant and alluring.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“唉，讨厌，你怎么也唱这种东西！

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Ah, how troublesome. Why are you singing that sort of thing too?

units.source_text: 要知道‘但愿天天常见面’[\[9\]](#part1336.html#m9)是不好的呀！”

en.t: You should know that 'I wish we could meet every day'[\[9\]](#part1336.html#m9) is not a good thing."

units.source_text: 便命侍女取过筝来，教紫姬弹奏。

en.t: He then ordered a maid to bring the koto and taught Lady Murasaki how to play it.

units.source_text: 对她说：“筝的三根细弦之中，中央一根最容易断[\[10\]](#part1336.html#m10)，要很当心。”

en.t: He said to her, "Of the koto's three fine strings, the middle one breaks most easily[\[10\]](#part1336.html#m10), so you must be very careful."

units.source_text: 便把琴弦重校一下，使降低为平调[\[11\]](#part1336.html#m11)；

en.t: Then he retuned the strings, lowering them to the hyojo mode[\[11\]](#part1336.html#m11);

units.source_text: 自己先调定了弦，然后把筝交紫姬弹奏。

en.t: after first setting the strings himself, he handed the koto to Lady Murasaki for her to play.

units.source_text: 紫姬终不好只管撒娇生气，便起来弹筝，弹得非常美妙。

en.t: Lady Murasaki could not keep sulking forever, so she sat up and played the koto, and her playing was wonderfully beautiful.

units.source_text: 她的身体还小，伸长左手去按弦，姿态美丽。

en.t: Her body was still small, and the way she stretched out her left hand to press the strings was beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了觉得十分可爱，便吹起横笛来辅导她。

en.t: Prince Genji found the sight very endearing and began to play the transverse flute to guide her.

units.source_text: 紫姬非常聪明，无论何等困难的曲调，只要教过一遍，便自会弹。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was extremely clever; no matter how difficult the melody, once she had been taught it once, she could play it on her own.

units.source_text: 如此多才多艺，伶俐可爱，完全符合源氏公子的希望，他觉得十分庆幸。

en.t: So talented, quick-witted, and lovable, she completely matched Prince Genji's hopes, and he felt deeply fortunate.

units.source_text: 《保曾吕俱世利》这个乐曲，名称不雅，但是曲调很好听。

en.t: The piece called "Hosoroguseri" had an inelegant name, but its melody was very pleasant to hear.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便在笛上吹这个乐曲，教紫姬弹筝相和。

en.t: Prince Genji played this piece on the flute and taught Lady Murasaki to accompany him on the koto.

units.source_text: 她弹得虽然生硬些，然而拍子一点也不错，真是能手！

en.t: Although her playing was still somewhat stiff, her rhythm was not off in the slightest; she truly had talent.
